sms.help:
VetLink vet commands:
Y4821 accept job, N4821 decline
OTW 4821 on my way, ARR 4821 arrived
DONE 4821 diagnosis; drugs; f/u 7d
ON / OFF availability
sms.helpFarmer: VetLink: dial *123# to request a vet. To rate a visit reply R and the request number with 1-5, e.g. R4821 5.
sms.unregistered: VetLink: dial *123# to request a vet, or get the VetLink app.
sms.accepted: Job {ref} is yours. Farmer: {farmer}, {phone}. Ward: {ward}. {notes}Reply OTW {ref} when you set off.
sms.taken: Sorry, job {ref} was already taken by another vet.
sms.noJob: There is no open job {ref} for you.
sms.needId: Which job? Reply {cmd} with the job number, e.g. {cmd}4821.
sms.enRoute: OK. The farmer knows you are on the way (job {ref}). Reply ARR {ref} when you arrive.
sms.arrived: OK, marked arrived (job {ref}). Reply DONE {ref} diagnosis; drugs; f/u 7d when finished.
sms.done: Job {ref} completed. Thank you! Your notes are saved.
sms.online: You are ONLINE. You will get job offers. Reply OFF to stop.
sms.offline: You are OFFLINE. You will not get job offers. Reply ON to start again.
sms.notVerified: Your VetLink account is not yet verified. We will SMS you when it is approved.
sms.invalidStep: Job {ref} cannot do that now. Reply HELP for the commands.
sms.rateHow: To rate, reply R and the request number with 1-5, e.g. R{ref} 5.
sms.rateNone: There is no finished request to rate.
sms.tooMany: Too many messages. Please wait a few minutes.
sms.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
